summary: Implemented U3 (deepen-skill) and U4 (planning-contract) for group g3. Confirmed via new tests in tests/test_plan_sections.py that Edge cases/Non-goals/Run:/Pass: bullets already parse harmlessly through the existing plan_sections/_split_bullets machinery with zero production code changes needed, and that a Run:/Pass: bullet assembles into exactly one VerificationItem. Wrote skills/orchestrator-deepen/SKILL.md and explorer-prompt.md defining the standalone interactive deepen skill (per-group explorer subagents walking a ten-category edge-case taxonomy, 3-5 EVPI-ranked questions per group with candidate answers always offered, grounded Run:/Pass: verification, all writes routed through plan_edit.py + plan-check --against). Updated skills/orchestrator-plan/SKILL.md Phase 7 to offer `split` after the advisory and print the `/orchestrator-deepen` command at the end, removing the 'wave-2 capability that does not exist yet' sentence, and added optional Edge cases/Non-goals/Run:/Pass: slots to its unit template. Documented `split` and `plan-check` (flags, non-destructive/zero-LLM semantics) in docs/orchestrator-grouping.md, and the byte-for-byte split preservation guarantee in docs/orchestrator-task-map.md. Verified every command/flag named in the three docs exists in live `--help` output. Full test suite passes except 5 pre-existing failures unrelated to my changes (tmpfs cross-device-link and CLI banner flakiness, confirmed via git diff that I never touched those files).
